hypotheses.statement: Refundable deposit is not shown on the /hire listing (16 items linking to /hire detail pages) and is only visible after 1 hop on the individual /hire detail pages (e.g. $100 on cordless-drill-driver-kit-18v, $150 on sds-plus-rotary-hammer-26mm), forcing agents to open each machine page to compare deposits.

Minimum hire is not shown on the /hire listing and is only visible after 1 hop on individual /hire detail pages (e.g. Minimum hire 1 day on detail pages), forcing exhaustive per-item visits that agents truncated (2 of 3 evidence pages visited).

Delivery and collection status (Optional vs Required for this item) is not shown on the /hire listing and is only visible after 1 hop on individual /hire detail pages (e.g. Optional on drill, rotary hammer pages), forcing exhaustive visits; trials visited 4 of 5 evidence pages and failed.

Agents asked to compare the refundable deposit, minimum hire period and delivery requirements across the hire machines use nearly their whole step budget opening each machine's detail page, because those three fields appear only on the detail pages. Showing the same three facts on the listing cards would let the comparison be made from the listing pages. (Unverified; owner-selected.)
hypotheses.prediction: With the three fields shown on the listing cards, the agent answers each of the four frozen comparison tasks with at most 75% of the model requests it needs on the unmodified site and without losing any evidence-backed pass; the effect is larger than the run-to-run difference between the unmodified repeat and the historical baseline.

rule.void_policy: a pair with any void trial in either arm is excluded and listed
rule.causal_scope: measured on these frozen tasks, this agent profile and model, this snapshot and patch only

results.reason: neither the improvement nor the regression rule is met

exploratory.label: EXPLORATORY - owner-selected change; separate from the frozen paired-signflip-v1 rule; never its replacement

rules.label: EXPLORATORY - owner-selected change; separate from the frozen paired-signflip-v1 rule; never its replacement
rules.primary_comparison: contemporaneous unmodified repeat (placebo) vs patched trial, per affected task, model requests
rules.secondary_comparison: imported historical baseline vs patched trial (same tasks)
rules.support: for EVERY affected task: patched requests <= (1 - effect_floor) x placebo requests; (placebo - patched) strictly exceeds the noise estimate; patched page views < placebo page views; no evidence-backed pass lost relative to the placebo
rules.noise_estimate: max over the placebo tasks of |placebo requests - historical baseline requests|
rules.controls: same-shape controls (have a placebo): |patched - placebo| requests <= tolerance; detail-page controls (no placebo): |patched - historical baseline| requests <= tolerance
rules.drift: affected task: |placebo - historical| / historical > 0.25 is flagged as drift
rules.conflict: any affected task where the two comparisons fall on opposite sides of the effect floor, or a drift flag, while the primary comparison would support H1

verdicts.consistent_with_h1: all support conditions hold, controls inside tolerance, no conflict
verdicts.not_supported: an affected task misses a support condition, or a pass is lost (the contemporaneous comparison governs; a supportive historical comparison alone changes nothing)
verdicts.inconclusive_conflicting_comparisons: the primary comparison would support H1 but the secondary conflicts or drift is flagged: no support is claimed
verdicts.uninterpretable: a control moved beyond tolerance, a trial is missing or void, or the control is not identical to the baseline

rules.claims: allowed: 'consistent with / not consistent with a reduction in browsing effort for this exploratory change on this site and these tasks'; never 'proved' or a general improvement

spend.basis: calculated at published prices from the spend ledger; not a bill

statement: Findings are website properties verified by deterministic checks; the trials that support them show an ASSOCIATION (the pattern coincided with failed or inefficient runs that nothing else explains), not a proven cause - only the pre-registered retest after a fix speaks to cause. Novel hypotheses are unverified and can only back EXPERIMENTAL proposals. A measured effect shows a change moved metrics on the measured tasks; it does not verify a hypothesis' mechanism.
